people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: The people said to Joshua, “We will serve Yahweh our God, and we will listen to his voice.”
translations.bsb: So the people said to Joshua, “We will serve the LORD our God and obey His voice.”
translations.kjv: And the people said unto Joshua, The LORD our God will we serve, and his voice will we obey.
translations.asv: And the people said unto Joshua, Jehovah our God will we serve, and unto his voice will we hearken.
